claims.claim: sdk.Open(packPath, promptName, opts...) returns (*Conversation, error)
first argument is a relative or absolute pack path
second argument is a prompt name under prompts in the pack
sdk.WithModel overrides the pack's model
sdk.WithGuardrail with guardrails.Input/Output(evalType, params)
banned_words guardrail takes params {"words": []any{...}}
guardrails.Output("length", {"max_characters": 2000})
sdk.WithToolHook and sdk.WithSessionHook register hooks
Hooks reference page exists at /runtime/reference/hooks/
one of OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY is required for auto-detection
errors.Is(err, sdk.ErrPackNotFound) matches a missing pack file
errors.Is(err, sdk.ErrPromptNotFound) matches a missing prompt
errors.Is(err, sdk.ErrProviderNotDetected) matches when no provider is found
Always close; conv.Close() releases the conversation
conv.SetVar(name, value string)
conv.Send(ctx, string) returns (*Response, error); resp.Text()
Open error for missing pack: 'failed to load pack <path>: failed to resolve pack path: pack file not found: <path>'
Open error for no provider: 'failed to detect provider: no provider detected: set OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or GOOGLE_API_KEY'
Open error for bad prompt: 'prompt "x" not found in pack (available: [...])'
An input guardrail that matches blocks the LLM call and returns a canned assistant reply
Open caches each loaded pack by absolute path for the life of the process
